title: Local digest runs attach permanent WorkInfo observers
reasoning: runDigestLocally registers an observeForever observer every time a local digest is triggered, but the observer is never removed and onCleared only cancels the polling job. Because observeForever is not lifecycle-bound, each run leaks the ViewModel callback and future WorkInfo updates will be delivered to stale or duplicate observers, causing retained ViewModels and repeated state updates.
reproduction: Trigger local digest generation, leave the settings screen, then trigger it again after recreating the ViewModel; the previous observeForever observer remains registered and still receives WorkInfo updates.
recommendation: Keep the Observer instance and remove it when the work reaches a terminal state and in onCleared, or observe a Flow/coroutine-backed WorkManager API scoped to viewModelScope instead of observeForever.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided, and a repo search found no SettingsViewModel tests or observer lifecycle assertions.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a SettingsViewModel unit test with fake LiveData from DigestScheduler that calls runDigestLocally twice and verifies the first observer is removed on terminal WorkInfo and on ViewModel clear.
